input.rationale: Sections 9.1 and 9.2 impose a symmetrical cap on each party at the greater of $100,000 or twelve months' charges paid, and indemnification payments (Section 8) and bodily injury/tangible property damage sit outside that cap; Section 10 excludes consequential damages mutually and expressly preserves Customer's payment obligations. The cap basis and mutuality therefore satisfy the fallback (the absent USD 1,000,000 floor is noted only as a sub-element short of preferred). However, the fallback also requires carve-outs for confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct, and none exist: Section 6 (p0080) provides that Sections 5, 9 and 10 prevail over the AECI for confidential information in the hosting environment, and Section 9.1(c)(2) excludes all liability for loss of or damage to Customer's records or data. Confidentiality and data-security exposure is thus capped or wholly excluded, which fails the fallback on a material term. We add a single mutual Excluded Claims paragraph (9.3) covering confidentiality/data and security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, leaving the cap amount untouched.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual "Excluded Claims" carve-out so confidentiality/data, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the Section 9/10 caps and exclusions.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The mutual cap and the 12-month fee basis work for us, but our playbook requires confidentiality and data/security breaches, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement to sit outside the cap and exclusions — as drafted Section 6 makes Sections 9 and 10 prevail over the AECI and Section 9.1(c)(2) excludes data loss entirely. We have added a single mutual carve-out sentence rather than reopening the cap amount.

ops.text: 9.3 Excluded Claims. Notwithstanding Sections 9.1, 9.2 and 10, the limitations and exclusions of liability in Sections 9.1, 9.2 and 10 do not apply to, and neither party's liability is limited or excluded for: (a) a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations (including loss of, or damage to, Customer's records or data); (b) a party's indemnification obligations under Section 8; (c) a party's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud; and (d) a party's infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights.
